note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (39.3 mm case, listing; strap 20.23 mm measured against 20 mm). Heights before the house depth scale (12.3 mm thick listing). The front photo is projected from the front on every part; the model only adds the side shape.

case.note: [on, radius, z]: 'case' = offset from the photo's case circle, 'pivot' = radius about the pivot. Flank, rounded shoulder, wide polished bezel rising inward to the crystal ring, inner lip down to the crystal seat

lug.note: short polished lugs curving down to the strap (3/4 view)

dial.note: flat dial (open heart and power reserve are print in the photo) to the minute track, the track a cone up to the crystal ring

hands.note: rose-gold dauphine hour and minute with tails, thin seconds needle; plates show the photographed hands

crown.note: fluted crown at 3 (photo: 6.5 mm across, 3.4 mm long)

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at each side's lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

photo_note: Daytona values: the photo as base colour and emission, no specular, so the photographed reflections are not lit twice

review.subtitle: Polished steel, grey sunburst open-heart dial with power reserve, rose-gold hands, black leather strap. The product photo is projected on the whole front; the side shape is 3D.
notes: Front: the product photo is projected straight from the front on every part (case, bezel, lugs, crown, dial, hands, strap), as on the Rolex Daytona. From the side the case, bezel, lugs, crown, hands and strap are real 3D.
The largest product photo found is 755 x 1126 px (official site: 328 px), so small dial print is soft when zoomed in.
The hands are also printed in the dial photo: from an angle a faint copy of the hands shows on the dial under the raised hands.
The photo is taken slightly from below, so the 6 o'clock lugs are longer than the 12 o'clock ones; the model follows the photo so the projection lines up.
The deployant clasp at 5 o'clock is left out. The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches.
